headline: UCLA shuts out Quinnipiac to close the MAAC season
dek: Quinnipiac had not lost since a September trip to Manhattan before falling at UCLA in the conference's final match. The table-topper closed the season with twelve wins and four defeats across all matches, conceding 24 goals against 28 scored.
displaced_by: Quinnipiac's loss at UCLA closed the MAAC season and changed the standing dek's loss and conceded-goal totals
